proposals.mechanism_class: event-driven both-sided single-name fade of forced flow

economic_source.statement: Payment for supplying immediacy into one-sided forced deleveraging: margin-engine liquidations transact regardless of level, pushing price away from levels supported by willing holders.
economic_source.counterparty_identity: leveraged retail/small-fund perpetual holders being force-deleveraged (insolvent longs sold out; mirror: liquidated shorts buying back), acting through a discretion-free clearing/margin engine
economic_source.why_they_exist: retail-accessible high leverage plus a maintenance-margin engine with no discretion on 24/7 markets produces bursty threshold-triggered unwinding; no data assumption beyond ten funded perpetuals with 15-minute liquidity
economic_source.predictability_claim: their motive is solvency, not opinion: pressure stops mechanically once margin deficit is cleared, leaving price displaced from willing-holder levels

series: open/high/low/close per completed 15m bar, external LAST basis, all ten selected symbols
qvol = native quote_volume per completed 15m bar (manifest-proven field used for pre-window ranking)
pit_inputs.pit_safety_justification: every quantity belongs to a bar fully closed before the signal stamp; normalizers trail and are inclusive of the signal bar alone; no centred/forward window; universe membership frozen strictly before the scored window opened

causal_sign.rule: LONG after capitulation-shaped down bars; SHORT after blow-off-shaped up bars
justification_chain: an involuntary seller must transact regardless of level, pushing price below willing-holder levels

because he sells until margin is restored, the terminal bar shows abnormal participation AND closes near its low: joint extreme in excursion x close-location x participation, not merely a large negative return
when the deficit clears, selling stops mechanically and no informational reason remains for further decline while resting bids remain
conditional expected return over following hours is positive => long; mirrored argument => short after forced-buying blow-offs

clocks.fill_clock: next allowed event = OPEN of next 15-minute bar strictly after signal stamp; exits also completed-bar driven, filled next open

holding_horizon.native_unit_rationale: deleveraging flush resolves within hours; spans at most one settlement boundary; cannot silently become a multi-day directional bet

definitions.sig_i: rolling std of r1 over L_sig=96 bars ending i inclusive

construction_recipe.entry_guards: require rng_t > 0 and every 96-bar window has >=67 available bars else suppress
construction_recipe.fill: next bar OPEN, unit exposure, single leg, no pyramiding
construction_recipe.position_rules: same-direction retrigger ignored; opposite-direction trigger closes-and-reverses next open
exit_precedence: time target bars_held == 16 -> exit next open
same triple fires with opposite sign -> exit (and reverse) next open
timeout identical to rule 1; explicitly no stop-loss and no profit target
construction_recipe.accounting: uniform policy block in this artifact's uniform_statistics_policy

proposals.mechanism_class: cross-instrument diffusion lag; single-name directional; benchmark input-only, never traded

economic_source.statement: Aggregate crypto-beta information reprices the deepest instrument first because institutional hedging/arbitrage concentrates there; diffusion into thinner alt books is incomplete within minutes because part of each alt's holder base updates late and multi-leg hedgers complete alt legs after the benchmark leg.
economic_source.counterparty_identity: delayed-repricing altcoin holders (passive allocators, hand-managed books, bots keyed only to alt-local indicators) and second-pass hedgers completing alt legs at reduced urgency
economic_source.why_they_exist: alts carry far larger per-name risk relative to desk capacity and nobody monitors twenty small books as continuously as the flagship book; institutional BTC-perp access coexists with retail alt access
economic_source.predictability_claim: after a completed benchmark shock a fraction of required alt repricing remains unexecuted, producing same-signed drift toward benchmark-implied fair value

series: BTCUSDT-PERP.BINANCE close series (completed 15m bars) as conditioning observable ONLY: manifest proves census gaps = 0 and ancestor manifest fixes role benchmark_measurement_only_excluded_from_ranking_weights_pnl
open/close per completed 15m bar for the ten selected symbols (traded legs)
r1 log-return series and trailing sigma estimators on both sides
pit_inputs.btc_usage_compliance: consistent with PLAN §11 'buy-and-hold/BTC-beta-neutral only context': no BTC leg opened, no BTC PnL scored, BTC neither added to nor removed from the traded universe
pit_inputs.pit_safety_justification: shock statistic uses benchmark bars closing at or before the signal stamp inclusive; normalization trails identically; decision instant equals completion time of last benchmark bar used, hence knowable then; shared manifest-documented 900s grid means no ordering ambiguity between benchmark and alt completions

causal_sign.rule: take the SAME sign as the completed benchmark shock in the alt
justification_chain: a benchmark shock signals changed aggregate beta demand, not single-name sentiment
transmission requires transactions in each alt book where transaction rates are lower (thinner restbook, wider quotes, slower holder update cycles)
until those transactions occur the alt understates the new beta level => drift toward fair value => same-signed continuation
diffusion completes => drift decays => fixed-horizon exit rather than stop/target; the mechanism predicts finite life, not trend
causal_sign.null_hypothesis_acknowledged: integration completing within one 15-minute bar is the most likely outcome; the cell bounds how much lag survives 15-minute granularity at 5bp cost

clocks.signal_clock: completed 15-minute closes, benchmark and alts aligned on the manifest-documented common 900s UTC grid
clocks.fill_clock: OPEN of the following 15-minute bar strictly after signal stamp; missing fill-instant bar suppresses that symbol's signal fail-closed, never back-filled

holding_horizon.native_unit_rationale: diffusion and basket-completion act over hours, so exit is a multiple of the diffusion window rather than a profit target; aligns to the settlement cadence boundary making funding accounting unambiguous

alt_reaction_statistic_neighbor_only.altmove_s_t: sum(ra_j ; j in [t-L_shk+1..t]) / (rolling_std(ra_j ; j=t-L_sig+1..t) * sqrt(L_shk)), L_sig=96

construction_recipe.side: dir_t (long if shock up, short if down)
construction_recipe.execution: fill next bar OPEN; hold exactly 32 bars; time exit only; no stop/target; further signals on a live symbol ignored (no stacking); max 10 concurrent equal-notional single-leg exposures; benchmark never traded
construction_recipe.accounting: uniform policy block, including native funding on held alts across settlements

idiosyncratic alt news cycles that correctly detach an alt from benchmark beta
strong one-directional regimes where an 8-h hold degenerates into beta and MDD dominates

proposals.mechanism_class: two-leg atomic spread mean-reversion against transient idiosyncratic flow

economic_source.statement: When idiosyncratic one-sided flow pushes exactly one of two highly correlated perpetuals, the shared-factor relationship is unbroken and relativizing balance sheets (delta-arb desks rotating back, funded sellers entering the rich leg) close the ratio divergence, paying whoever provides the other side.
economic_source.counterparty_identity: originators of one-sided single-name flow: allocation/unlock sellers, concentrated-book unwind desks, listing-driven rotators; plus passive makers swept asymmetrically in exactly one instrument
economic_source.why_they_exist: crypto capital is unevenly concentrated and frequently redeployed on schedules (vest calendars, collateral calls, index inclusion) unrelated to relative value between two perpetuals; nothing links one maker's SOL-specific exposure to another's XRP-specific exposure, so one-sided imbalances arise routinely and stay unhedged until arbitrageurs act
economic_source.predictability_claim: deviation created by such flow is closed on an intraday-to-one-day scale; temporary-versus-structural is the crux, which the participation-conditioned neighbor tests directly

pit_inputs.pair_selection_rule: two highest pre-window median-quote-volume symbols in the frozen universe => rank 1 ETHUSDT-PERP.BINANCE (leg B quote) and rank 2 SOLUSDT-PERP.BINANCE (leg A base), from selected_symbols.rank; depth measured in a window closing before the scored window opened; both legs show zero pre-window gaps and their only recorded scored-window gap is the explained ETH boundary run sitting before fold 1
pit_inputs.substitution_rule: NONE: if either leg fails a data gate the correct outcome is a hard data fail for this family, not a different pair
series: ln(close_SOL,t) and ln(close_ETH,t) per completed 15m bar
quote-volume z-score inputs per §P1 definitions (neighbor condition only)
pit_inputs.pit_safety_justification: pairs chosen from a pre-window manifest; spread statistics trail inclusively; no centred window, no forward fill, no use of either leg's own trend, no funding variable enters the signal

causal_sign.rule: short the rich leg / long the cheap leg when the log ratio is abnormally far from centre; close on reversion
justification_chain: unchanged shared factor implies the two prices' equilibrium ratio is locally anchored
deviation therefore arises from a single-name imbalance
imbalance-originating flow is finite by nature (discrete allocation decisions exhaust)
absorption by relativizers restores the ratio => positive expected spread PnL over the convergence window
payoff comes from the difference, so common-factor risk cancels structurally

clocks.signal_clock: completed 15-minute closes of BOTH legs on the shared 900s grid; both legs must have completed bars at the signal stamp else suppressed
clocks.fill_clock: both legs filled atomically at the OPEN of the next 15-minute bar, USD-equal notional at fill, two taker fees + ticks; if either leg's bar is missing NEITHER leg fills (fail-closed atomicity); exits likewise two simultaneous next-open fills

holding_horizon.value: max 48 bars = 12 hours, earlier on convergence
holding_horizon.native_unit_rationale: dislocations created by one-off flow are absorbed intraday; after 12h without convergence the mechanism story is dead and continued holding would be trend-following by inertia; timeout exits at market next open and is a normal exit, not a special loss case

construction_recipe.state_machine: at most ONE spread position globally; live-position signals ignored unless mirror extreme (abs(z_t)>=2.0 opposite side) which closes-and-reverses next open; precedence convergence, mirror reversal, timeout
construction_recipe.notional: N_A = N_B USD-equal at fill, re-marked, never resized mid-trade
construction_recipe.accounting: fees/slippage both legs, funding accrual separately per leg over held settlements, spread PnL = leg sum

edge_concentrates: choppy sideways tape with high pairwise correlation punctuated by episodic single-name flow shocks
high-volatility de-risking episodes where one leg moves first and others follow
edge_should_lose: structural relative-supply shifts: sustained emission/unlock schedules, protocol-specific drawdowns, delisting or insurance-fund intervention in one leg (correlation collapse, spread trends)
strong trending regimes where the rich leg keeps getting richer
hostile funding differentials repeatedly paying against one leg
